Hi Product Hunt! 👋

I'm Lindia, Co-founder of UseIt.

Five years ago, when I first stepped into the world of AI, I had a dream: what if AI could turn our wildest ideas into things we could actually hold in our hands?

A gift for someone special, a character you dreamed up, or something that simply didn't exist anywhere else.

Back then, it felt like a distant dream. But I've held onto that idea ever since.

And today, I'm incredibly excited to finally bring that dream to life with UseIt. 🥹

Meet UseIt, your AI-powered design studio for the physical world. [...] UseIt is how we're trying to get there. Tell it what you want, and it asks what a designer would ask, sets up the real structure, and designs on it. 👆 Circle any part to change just that. 📦 See it in 3D in real materials. 📐 Get an editable design file with real dimensions, ready for a manufacturer. Under the hood, the agent works directly in design software instead of generating a picture.

It's early. 🌱 Gift boxes, pins, stickers, pop-up cards and brand kits for now, and it won't get everything right yet. Tell me when it breaks, and tell me what you've always wanted to make 💬 That's how we decide what's next.

Thanks to @zaczuo for hunting us 🙏

results.content: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Bharath, the maker behind Invoke Studio. Every AI coding tool today can write, edit, and review code. That's table stakes. What's missing is everything around the code — planning what to build, designing how it looks, and safely experimenting before committing. Invoke Studio is a desktop IDE that covers the full development loop: Boards — Lay out features as cards on a canvas, draw dependency arrows, @mention files, hit Build. The AI implements the whole plan in order. Canvas — Describe a page, AI generates it with real design. Edit visually — drag, resize, tweak — then export into your actual codebase as production code. Review MindStudio?

Reviewers describe MindStudio as unusually easy to start with, letting nontechnical users build useful AI agents quickly through a clear visual workflow builder and setup wizard. They repeatedly praise fast prototyping, broad model choice, and practical use across research, summarization, client work, and internal automation. More advanced users also value observability, version control, and reusable workflows. The main caveat is that deeper features like custom functions, complex logic, and integrations take real study, and some reviewers note limits for heavier use and a need to avoid overwhelming users as the platform expands.
